key.name: enable-fallback-menu
key.summary: Show a generic fallback menu for apps without a native menu

key.name: shortcut-menus-enabled
key.summary: Show curated shortcut-based menus for supported apps without a native menu

key.name: shortcuts-revision
key.summary: Bumped by the preferences after saving a mapping file, so the extension reloads its store

key.name: debug-shortcut-menus
key.summary: Verbose logging of shortcut-menu resolution and key synthesis

key.name: blur-popups
key.summary: Blur behind popup menus via Blur My Shell (no effect if it is not running)

key.name: popup-blur-brightness
key.summary: Brightness of the blurred area behind popups (1.0 = no dimming)

key.name: popup-opacity
key.summary: Popup menu background opacity in percent (translucency needed for blur to show)

key.name: popup-corner-radius
key.summary: Popup menu corner radius in pixels

key.name: hide-popup-arrow
key.description: Menus drop straight down from the bar instead of leaving a gap and pointing at the button.

key.name: hide-app-name
key.description: Removes the button at the start of the menu bar that shows the focused app's name. The menus after it stay where they are.

key.name: button-spacing
key.summary: Horizontal padding of the menu-bar buttons in pixels (GNOME default is 12)

key.name: menu-font-size
key.summary: Font size of the menu bar and popups in points (0 = theme default)

key.name: bold-app-name
key.summary: Show the app-name button in bold

key.name: hide-workspace-indicator
key.summary: Hide GNOME's Activities and workspace pill indicator at the left of the panel
